ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $AO \perp BO$, $CO \perp DO$, where $O$ is the foot of the perpendiculars, $\angle BOC = 50^\circ$. What is the degree measure of $\angle AOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $AO\perp BO$, $CO\perp DO$,\\
therefore, $\angle AOB = \angle COD = 90^\circ$,\\
since $\angle AOB + \angle BOC + \angle COD + \angle AOD = 360^\circ$, and $\angle BOC = 50^\circ$,\\
thus, $90^\circ + 50^\circ + 90^\circ + \angle AOD = 360^\circ$,\\
we find that $\angle AOD = \boxed{130^\circ}$.
